notes.method: Products were read on 2026-10-02 from IKEA's own data for each country site: the category and search JSON that ikea.com's pages load (sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/{country}/{lang}/product-list-page and /search-result-page), and each chosen product's own page (ikea.com/{country}/{lang}/p/...) for measurements. "source" is the product page. Delivery and assembly were read from the customer-service pages. Spot checks of price and article number against the rendered product pages matched: US ÖNNESTAD $99 (195.544.77), UK GÄVLE £29 (505.888.42), CA ÅRSUNDA C$79.99 and MX ÅRSUNDA MX$1,799 (305.358.97).
notes.selection: For each kind and market: the live products of that kind in IKEA's category (sellable online, not discontinued or last chance), one colourway per model and size (the cheapest), sorted by the price a non-member pays; then the two cheapest and the median one ("mid-range"). Wardrobes add the cheapest BRIMNES and KLEPPSTAD; chests add the cheapest MALM, HEMNES and KULLEN and the dearest HEMNES; bookcases are BILLY and KALLAX, each picked the same way; PAX frames are their own kind, wardrobeFrame. chosenAs on each product says why it was taken.
notes.prices: "price" is what a non-member pays on the read date. US and Canadian prices are before sales tax; UK and Irish prices include VAT; Mexican prices include IVA. Where IKEA showed an IKEA Family member price (FAMILY_PRICE), price is the regular price and memberPrice the member's, with IKEA's validity dates. NEW_LOWER_PRICE is IKEA's published lowered price, which anyone pays; previousPrice is the figure it replaced, and priceValidFrom/To are IKEA's own window for it. LOWER_CURRENT_REGULAR_PRICE_IN_STORE and NEW_PRODUCT are IKEA's own tags, kept for reference.
notes.articleNumbers: Article numbers are IKEA's, formatted 3.3.2 as its pages print them. articleKind SPR means IKEA sells several articles as one product (a sofa frame and cover, a table top and legs, a set of frames); the number is the combination's.
notes.dimensions: widthCm, depthCm and heightCm are outside dimensions from the Measurements section of the product page. IKEA US publishes inches only; those are converted at 2.54 cm per inch and rounded to 0.1 cm, and measurementsAsPublished keeps the original. Canada publishes cm with inches. Tables are given as Length and Width: Length is recorded as width and Width as depth. Round tables give Diameter, recorded as both width and depth. For sofas and chairs height is the overall Height, else Height including back cushions, else Backrest height; dimensionBasis says which was used. outsideVolumeLitres = W x D x H / 1000 for wardrobes, PAX frames, chests and bookcases: it is derived here, not published, and is the outside box, not usable storage. Where IKEA publishes "Storage capacity" (some chests, in litres), it is in measurementsAsPublished.
notes.seats: Armchairs and chairs seat one. Sofas: IKEA's own Number of Seats filter where it puts the product under exactly one count, else its 2-seat or 3-seat sofa category in that market, else the seat count in IKEA's product type name in that market; seatsBasis says which. Dining tables: IKEA's own seat filter, whose buckets are "Up to 2/4/6/8 seats"; seats is the largest bucket IKEA files the table under, and seatsBasis lists them all. A table IKEA did not file under any seat bucket has seats null.
gaps: MALM chests of drawers: none sellable online in the US, Canada, Mexico or Ireland on 2026-10-02. In the UK only the MALM chest of 4 drawers (£115) is live; the MALM chest of 2 drawers was tagged discontinued in the UK (£39) and last chance in Ireland (€49). Searching each site for "malm" found only MALM beds in North America.
HEMNES chests: none in Canada or Mexico (searches found HEMNES beds, cabinets and desks only). The US lists HEMNES 2-, 3-, 6- and 8-drawer pieces; the UK the 3- and 8-drawer; Ireland the 3-drawer.
KULLEN: only the UK lists it online (chest of 2 drawers, £29). Ireland lists the same chest at €35 but marks it not sellable online, so it was not taken. Not found in the US, Canada or Mexico.

PAX: the US, Canada and Mexico no longer list a single "Wardrobe frame". They sell the PAX "Wall-mounted storage frame" (widths 50, 75 and 100 cm; 35 or 58 cm deep; 201 or 236 cm high) and sets of frames, recorded as kind wardrobeFrame. The UK and Ireland still sell "Wardrobe frame".
US ÖNNESTAD armchair ($99): its page shows measurements only in an illustration, with no values, so its dimensions are null.
UK and Irish GÄVLE easy chair: IKEA publishes depth, height and seat width (54 cm) but no overall width, so widthCm is null.
Some dining tables have seats null because IKEA filed them under no seat bucket (US ÅLHULT, UK NORRMJÖLE; Ireland files the same NORRMJÖLE under up to 4).
US GLOSTAD (2-seat $169, 3-seat $199) is listed but marked not sellable online in the US, so the US cheapest sofas taken are SALTMYRAN and KLIPPAN. It is sold online in the other four markets.
Mexico's delivery service page renders its prices by script; the FAQ page's figures were used.
Per-item assembly rates are not published in the US, Canada, the UK or Ireland (quoted only in the cart); only the minimums or the call-out fee are.
checkWorthy: IKEA GB, IE and MX call the 171 cm GLOSTAD a 3-seat sofa, and IKEA Canada files the same article under three-seater sofas, while its seat width is 164 cm; the US calls it only "Sofa".
Mexico's VUKU wardrobe (MX$399, 74 x 51 x 149 cm) is a fabric wardrobe, far cheaper than any board wardrobe: real, but not like for like.
Mexican KLEPPSTAD and FRÖTORP carry NEW_LOWER_PRICE to 2027-08-31; UK and Irish KALLAX and the Irish KIVIK to 2027-02-22/23. These may revert to previousPrice.
Mexico's IKEA Family prices (VIHALS chair, FJÄLLBO, LACK coffee table) run 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-04.
US dimensions are conversions from fractional inches; small differences from the cm other markets publish for the same article (BILLY 27.9 vs 28 cm) are rounding, not different products.
The Irish KIVIK 3-seat at €549 is lower than the €599 SLATE keeps in furniture.ts; IKEA shows €599 as the previous price under a NEW_LOWER_PRICE window to 2027-02-22.
